subject: physics

hotspots.label: Coaster Track
hotspots.description: The hill-and-loop route where stored height becomes motion and back.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm metal rail climbing to a peak and looping.
hotspots.function: Carries the cart through every energy swap.

hotspots.label: Cart
hotspots.description: The rider carrying the energy around the loop — its form changes but its total never does.
hotspots.colorHint: Red seat riding the crest of the hill.
hotspots.function: Moves through the energy changes shown in the readout.

hotspots.label: Energy Readout
hotspots.description: The live stack of stored, motion, heat, and total bars at the track edge.
hotspots.colorHint: Stacked green/amber/grey bars on a pale panel.
hotspots.function: Shows the form split and the constant total.

hotspots.label: Stored (Height) Share
hotspots.description: The potential-energy slice — tall at the crest, drained on the dive.
hotspots.colorHint: Amber fill in the readout stack.
hotspots.function: Marks the potential portion of the total.

hotspots.label: Motion Share
hotspots.description: The kinetic slice — climbs exactly as the stored share drains.
hotspots.function: Marks the kinetic portion of the total.

hotspots.label: Heat Share
hotspots.description: The tiny heat slice from friction — small, but it never lets the total drop.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm grey fill low in the stack.
hotspots.function: Shows energy leaving motion for warmth.

hotspots.label: Total Line
hotspots.description: The flat marker at the top of the stack — always the same height.
hotspots.colorHint: A thin black constant line over the panel.

hotspots.label: Launch Button
hotspots.description: Tap to send the cart down the first hill and run the loop.
hotspots.colorHint: Round amber launch pedal on the ground.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper background, soft vignette, pastel hillside. A warm grey loop of track with a red cart and a pale readout panel of stacked bars.
materialNotes: Track metallic-roughness with metallic ~0.3; cart smooth red; readout panel pale with green/amber fills, no emissive.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: conservation of energy on a roller-coaster loop.

GEOMETRY: a hill climbing to y≈1.9 with a loop to the right; red cart; a readout panel (1.6,1.1,0) with stacked stored/motion/heat bars and a total line; launch button (-1.5,0.3,0).

INTERACTION: launch runs the cart; each frame the stack recomputes from height and speed; heat accrues with distance; total stays the same.

NAMED NODES: TrackLoop, Cart, PanelStored, PanelMotion, PanelHeat, PanelTotal, LaunchButton. 8-11k tris.
